# v1.5.0 - Agentic Delivery, Worktrees and AI Code Review
## Projects 27 v1.5.0: Agentic Delivery, Worktrees and AI Code Review

Work that outgrows one session runs in fresh contexts with state on disk, parallel agents get their own worktrees, and AI code review reports exactly what it did.

### Key Highlights
- **Rule 19 (`19-agentic-delivery-and-review.md`)**: fresh context per unit, worktree isolation, unattended runs bounded and sandboxed without permission bypass, AI review outcomes reported exactly. Units that touch money, ledgers, periods, tax or migrations need exact-amount checks and a person's review.
- **Skills**: `agent-delivery-loop` (GSD phase loop and Ralph story loop, with tested helpers), `git-worktrees` (with this product's ports and per-worktree databases) and `coderabbit-review` (with a `.coderabbit.yaml` template carrying an "Exact money" check).

### Verification
- Local checks before release: `npm run verify`, 29 helper tests, schema validation of the CodeRabbit template, docs completeness check.

**Full changelog**: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gerrardgs/Projects27/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
